summary: Usertour is a self-hosted user onboarding platform designed to help you build in-app product tours, interactive checklists, and user surveys. It provides a centralised way to guide users through software interfaces without relying on third-party cloud services.
goodFor: Teams that need to design product walkthroughs and gather user feedback directly within their own applications while maintaining strict data privacy.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence may have strict copyleft implications if you modify the code and offer it as a service to external users.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
